meta.name: Passport x layover country exit rules
meta.overridesSource: News and travel sites, not government pages. Verify every row on the official immigration site.
meta.disclaimer: Normal tourist entry rules, not airport transit rules. Not legal or visa advice. Entry is always at the discretion of immigration officers.
meta.hoursBoundsNote: hoursMin and hoursMax were extracted only from explicit numbers in the override rule text.

matrixLegend.Y: can_leave (visa free or visa on arrival)

meta.matrixOrder: Each matrix string has 199 characters, one per entry of countries, same order.

overrides.rule: Visa-free; digital arrival card (MDAC) required; arrangement valid to 31 Dec 2026; stay length differs by source (30-90 days)
overrides.note: News/travel sites, 2026

overrides.rule: Visa-free for 30 days from 15 Sep 2026 with digital arrival card (dataset shows 60 days); sources conflicted during 2026
overrides.note: Wikipedia/Passport Index; verify with Thai embassy

overrides.rule: Newer lists show visa-free 14 days (some say 30 days with conditions); dataset says visa required
overrides.note: Conflicting sources; verify

overrides.rule: Visa-free 90 days
overrides.note: Passport Index dashboard

overrides.rule: Free transit visa through the airline on longer layovers (over 8 h); 96-hour paid option also exists
overrides.note: Travel blog; confirm with Emirates/flydubai

overrides.rule: Free visa on arrival (30 days); Qatar Airways passengers can get a free transit visa for 5-96 h layovers
overrides.note: Travel sites; confirm with airline

overrides.rule: 96-hour visa-free transit facility for eligible Indians travelling onward to a third country; conditions apply
overrides.note: News; confirm on ICA Singapore site

overrides.rule: Airport transit visa removed from 3 Jun 2026 for airside transit only; leaving the airport still needs a Schengen visa
overrides.note: German Embassy India announcement

overrides.rule: Airport transit visa exemption since Apr 2026 for airside transit only; leaving needs a Schengen visa
overrides.note: News (Wego)
